business: UrbanMart operates physical retail stores and an online shopping platform.

rules.rule: Standard orders are normally delivered within 2 to 3 working days.
Customer issues should receive an initial response within 24 hours.

management_priority: Improve customer satisfaction and encourage repeat purchases.
improvement_approach: Management prefers practical improvements that can initially be implemented without major infrastructure investment.
decision_authority: AI can analyse information and recommend improvements, but management must approve operational changes.

sentiment.Positive: Customer expresses satisfaction or positive experience.

severity.Medium: Meaningful issue negatively affecting customer experience.
severity.High: Serious issue, repeated failure, or problem with significant customer impact.
